modifications: Converted official FBX to independent named Draco GLB structures; removed annotation-helper geometry; applied FBX hierarchy transforms and converted centimetres to metres; 18-bit position quantization. Mirrored transform winding corrected. No anatomical meshes invented. Original FBX Tendon material faces restored as scalar masks; optional 1.5 mm display feather remains inside authored tendon faces. Original geometry, identifiers and bounds retained. Source-authored Tendon boundary interpolation repaired with planar edge midpoint/face centroid display subdivisions. Original anatomical surfaces and source IDs retained; render tessellation is not additional anatomical detail. Cool off-white nonmetal display material, roughness 0.52, and per-mesh inside-boundary feather capped at 3 mm.

coordinates.sourceToApp: Apply complete FBX node world transform, then divide positions by 100. This model is not spatially registered to BodyParts3D 4.0.

limitations: Selected meshes are CC BY-SA 4.0; the complete independent Z-Anatomy atlas has mixed underlying terms.
The original package does not include a separately modeled distal dorsal nerve of penis, genital skin, prepuce, tunica albuginea or intramural terminal vasculature.
The named dorsal and superficial veins do not encode their full separate proximal drainage pathways.
No mesh was fitted, synthesized, mirrored or remeshed for this subset.

subset.modifications: Whole original male genital, urethral and named vascular surfaces and compressed source attributes retained; glTF tables and byte offsets compacted.
subset.scope: Glans, corpora cavernosa, corpus spongiosum, urethra, bilateral internal pudendal/dorsal/deep penile arteries, bilateral internal pudendal veins and named dorsal veins.
